div.head: Rect 4
div.ab: [4] Gebures gerihte. Geburgerihta syn mislice: gehwar hy syn hefige, gehwar eac medeme.
De geburi consuetudine. Geburi consuetudines inueniuntur multimode et ubi sunt onerose et ubi sunt (leuiores aut) medie.
GEBVRES GE|RIHTE . Gebur gerihta syn mislice . gehwar hy syn hefige . gehwar eac mederne .
Gebures gerihte Geburgerihta syn mislice: gehwar hy syn hefige; gehwar eac medeme.
4. Des Bauern Rechtspflichten. Bauernrechtspflichten sind verschieden: an einem Ort sind sie schwer, anderswo auch mässig.
4. The gebur's duties. The gebur's duties vary: in one place they are heavy, elsewhere also moderate.
The duty of the peasant The duties of the peasant are diverse, in some places they might be heavier, elsewhere [more] moderate.
The Duty of the Tenant Farmer The tenant farmer’s duties vary: in some places they are heavy; likewise, in others they are moderate.
div.note: K: ‘hefige,’ supplied from Liebermann, where it had dropped out. Liebermann notes that the customs of Tidenham continue here: ‘Se gebur sceal his riht don: he sceal erian healfne æcer to wiceworce …’.
tenant farmer’s duties: That is, a tenant of peasant status whose rental included both homestead and farmland. Candlemas: February 2, also referred to as the Feast of the Purification of the Virgin.
